meta.title: TokenBank Multi-Account
meta.description: Multi-account TokenBank for DSH free models: manage several TokenBank accounts in one panel, switch at any time, check in with one click, and see balances. Switching accounts swaps the model group API key (credentials are re-resolved on every request, no restart needed). Based on dsh-tokenbank; recharge, deposit and trading entry points were removed. Site https://bank.skillpie.cn

switchKeyFailed: Switched, but writing the model key failed
modelLinked: Linked {n} models; use the model picker above the input to switch
